guitar.evidence: Trained knowledge: Cabrel is known to favor Lowden acoustic guitars in recent decades alongside Stratocasters for electric work; less associated with Martin/Gibson J-45.
guitar.notes: Corrected acoustic brand from Martin/Gibson-style to Lowden, which is more specifically documented for Cabrel.

tone.target: warm clean arpeggio tone with subtle chorus and room reverb
tone.profile: warm clean arpeggio tone with subtle chorus and room reverb
tone.summary: A pristine, intimate arpeggiated sound built around a clean US Deluxe amp model, enhanced by Chorus for width and Room reverb for warmth.

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and fingerpicking transients.
Smooth out dynamics and add sustain for arpeggios.
blocks.gap: The Comp module is ideal for fingerpicked material, providing even tone without aggressive boost.

blocks.purpose: Keep the tone clean and transparent.
blocks.gap: No drive needed; keeping this module bypassed is key to the intimate sound.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the warm, clean sound of a Fender-style amp.
Provide a bright, articulate sound suitable for clean arpeggios.
Slightly scoop the bass and boost mids/highs for clarity in arpeggios.
blocks.gap: A subtle EQ adjustment is needed to maintain definition without sounding thin.

blocks.purpose: Add the required subtle stereo width and vintage chorus effect.
Create a warm, intimate sense of space without excessive wash.
blocks.gap: Room reverb is perfect for the 'intimate' and 'warm' tone requested.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism and warmth for intimate arpeggios.

proposals.reason: Enhance the warm, vintage character of clean fingerpicking tones.
